text_en: On that day a fountain shall be opened for the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
text_cn: 在那一天，为达味家和耶路撒冷的居民将开放一个水泉， 为洗涤罪过和不洁。

text_en: On that day, says the Lord of hosts, I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, so that they shall be remembered no more; and also I will remove from the land the prophets and the unclean spirit.
text_cn: 在那一天──万军上主的断语──我要由地上铲除一切偶像的名号，不再为人所记念；并且我还要将假先知们和不洁的神由地上灭绝。

text_en: And if any prophets appear again, their fathers and mothers who bore them will say to them, “You shall not live, for you speak lies in the name of the Lord ”; and their fathers and their mothers who bore them shall pierce them through when they prophesy.
text_cn: 将来，如果有人还要冒充先知，生养他的父母必要对他说：你不能生存，因为你藉上主的名字说了谎话。生养他的父母就在他说妙语时，要把他刺死。

text_en: On that day the prophets will be ashamed, every one, of their visions when they prophesy; they will not put on a hairy mantle in order to deceive,
text_cn: 到那一天，每个假先知，在他说妙语时，必因自己的神视感到羞惭；他们必不再穿毛外氅，去行欺骗；

text_en: but each of them will say, “I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the soil; for the land has been my possession since my youth. ”
text_cn: 他反要说：我不是先知，我是一个种田的人，因为我自幼就以务农为业。

text_en: And if anyone asks them, “What are these wounds on your chest? ” the answer will be “The wounds I received in the house of my friends. ”
text_cn: 若有人问他说：怎么在你两手上有这些伤痕？他要答说：那是我在爱我的人家里所受的伤。

text_en: “Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, against the man who is my associate, ” says the Lord of hosts. Strike the shepherd, that the sheep may be scattered; I will turn my hand against the little ones.
text_cn: 刀剑，起来攻击我的牧人，攻击那作我同伴的人──万军上主的断语。打击牧人，羊群就要四散， 然而我要向那弱小的羊伸出我的手。

text_en: In the whole land, says the Lord , two-thirds shall be cut off and perish, and one-third shall be left alive.
text_cn: 将来在全国──上主的断语──三分之二必被铲除而死去，其中只留下三分之一。

text_en: And I will put this third into the fire, refine them as one refines silver, and test them as gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “They are my people”; and they will say, “The Lord is our God. ”
text_cn: 我要使这三分之一经过火炼，炼净他们如同炼净银子，试验他们如同试验金子。他们必要呼号我的名字，我也必要俯听他们；我要说：“这是我的百姓。”他们每人也要说：“上主是我的天主。”
